term: accessible target exemplar outside a known limiting property
definition: PossiblyOutsideAt F Q Phi w is the existing Dia F of an individual c satisfying Phi c v and not Q c v at the SAME accessible v. It carries more information than possible target exemplification alone. No actualist existence predicate, classifier truth, power, necessity or frame law is built in.
note: The existing generic KnownLimitingAt/NonlimitingAt/BackwardClosedAt plus explicit EM yield this witness by excluding boxed Phi-to-Q inclusion. This stronger consequence requires a direct proof; the old possible theorem does not expose a counterexample outside Q.
